Underage Gaming Policy

Effective Date: June 4, 2025

Our Zero-Tolerance Stance on Underage Gaming

Our services are strictly for individuals aged 18 and over. This policy outlines our commitment to preventing underage access, the verification measures in place, and the responsibilities of the account holder to ensure a safe environment.

1. Age Requirement

Use of and registration on our website is strictly prohibited to anyone under the age of 18 or the legal age for gambling in your jurisdiction. It is your personal responsibility to know and comply with these legal requirements.

2. User Verification

We require all users to prove their age through identity verification. This is done by providing a valid, government-issued document (e.g., Passport, National ID) that clearly shows your name, photo, and date of birth. We reserve the right to refuse verification if there is any doubt about the document's authenticity or the user's age.

3. Account Holder Responsibility

As the verified account holder, you are solely responsible for controlling who has access to your account. You must ensure that no minors can access our services through your account.

  • Do not share your login details (username and password) with anyone.
  • Do not use software features that save or auto-fill your password on shared devices.
  • If you suspect a minor has accessed your account, you must notify us immediately at firelong921@gmail.com.

4. Parental Controls

If you have minors in your household, we strongly advise you to install parental control software to block access to all online gaming websites. The following tools can help:

  • Net Nanny
  • SafetoNet
  • GamBlock

5. Policy Enforcement

If we find that you have violated this policy, or if we discover that a minor has accessed our services through your account, your account will be permanently blocked without possibility of recovery.
